name: enterprise-fullstack-boilerplate
description: Enterprise Monorepo Boilerplate with Bun, React 18 (MVVM), Hono v4 (Clean Architecture), Drizzle ORM, and Biome

scripts.lint: bun run --cwd frontend lint && bun run --cwd backend lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run --cwd frontend lint:fix && bun run --cwd backend lint:fix
scripts.format: bun run --cwd frontend format && bun run --cwd backend format
scripts.build: bun run --cwd frontend build && bun run --cwd backend build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd backend test && bun run --cwd frontend test
